chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Show people at the Nest, and Louis and Hines opening the Sunset
summary: Zutty names theatrical visitors, including Carl Sandburg; King Oliver wanted Louis at the Plantation but Louis opened at the Sunset across the street, with Earl Hines.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well you said when we were talking last time, you know you said a lot of theatrical people would come there? That's where Revels came wasn't it?

Yes Ravel and Paul Sandburg he used to come up there a lot. Yes because he was good friends with Nora Ray Holt and that other gal, what was her name Marge that sang and became and entertained at the Apex? You know her husband passed away.
That wasn't May Alex? there was it?
No. Alex was across the street at the Sunset.

Where Louis was playing for them. That's a little falling out that King Oliver and Louis had. Because King Oliver wanted Louis to come into the Plantation. Instead, Louis opened at the Sunset right across the street from the old Nest.
And he opened as a leader?
